## What problem does it solve

Describe the situation you are in and what is awkward today.

## Proposed solution

What you would like to happen.

## Alternatives considered

Any workaround you already use, or a different approach you thought about.

## Scope check

This project stays deliberately small: **zero runtime dependencies** and no modification of Koodo's
files. If your idea needs either, say so — it is still worth discussing, but it changes the design.
